name: CITIC Telecom International Holdings Limited
summary: CITIC Telecom International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of international telecommunications services in Hong Kong, China, Macau, Singapore, and internationally. It provides international voice services; SMS services, such as A2P, P2P, and inter operator SMS; mobile value-added services that include mobile roaming signalling, SIMN, prepaid roaming SIM, MVNE, GMVNO, USSD, IPX, and SMS firewall services; datamall; internet; internet of the things; global mobile number smart authentication services; and cross border 5G SD WAN services.
